text:
sam: Noticing higher OOM evictions on eu-west-1 gpu pool. Correlated with keystore auth failures earlier today?
maria: Yes, saw nodes getting ejected because attach step timed out -> kube marked as NotReady and evicted pods. Keystore 403s earlier caused attach to hang ~30s for some nodes.
elliot: Root cause timeline: 08:10 IAM policy change added SourceVpc condition; 08:12 default-deny FW rollout started; 08:20 provisioning errors spike; 08:28 alert fired.
ops-bot: [ALERT] gpu-pool-eu-west memory_eviction_rate spike > 0.05
sam: Quick ask: did anyone snapshot the keystore audit logs for 08:00-09:00? Need them for postmortem and for security review.
maria: I pulled logs to `sre-keystore-audit` bucket before the rollback. Included the `AssumeRole` 403s.
elliot: We should also check if the IAM condition rollout PR had proper staging tests. It skipped the canary tag.
sam: Action items: 1) postmortem (owner: sam) 2) add canary gating for IAM condition changes (owner: elliot) 3) integrate smoke check into firewall rollout pipeline (owner: maria).
maria: Also propose we add a fallback attach path to a cross-region keystore replica for critical attach paths. Might cost some latency but reduces evictions during regional keystore issues.
ops-bot: Metric update: after rollback attach failures dropped to <1% and OOM evictions normalized.
sam: Filing postmortem draft now. Will attach logs and timeline.
